title: Graduation Rates for 4-year institutions
note:
Section table (defines cohort)
1 - Establishing cohorts, cohort year 2020
2 - Subcohort of full-time, first-time students seeking a bachelor's or equivalent degree, cohort year 2020
3 - Subcohort of full-time, first-time students seeking other than a bachelor's degree, cohort year 2020

Establishing cohort table (section 1)
1 - Revised cohort of all full-time, first-time degree or certificate seeking undergraduates, cohort year 2020
2 - Subcohort of full-time, first-time students seeking a bachelor's or equivalent degree, cohort year 2020
3 - Subcohort of full-time, first-time students seeking other than a bachelor's degree, cohort year 2020. Do not include in import file, will be generated.

Cohort status table (sections 2 and 3)
11 - Completers of programs of less than 2 years within 150% of normal time
12 - Completers of programs of at least 2 but less than 4 years within 150% of normal time
18 - Completers of bachelor's or equivalent degree programs within 150% of normal time
19 - Completers of bachelor's or equivalent degree programs in 4 years or less
20 - Completers of bachelor's or equivalent degree programs in 5 years
21 - Completers of bachelor's or equivalent degree programs in 6 years Do not include in import file, will be generated.
29 - Total completers within 150% of normal time. Do not include in import file, will be generated.
30 - Total transfer-out students (non-completers)
45 - Total exclusions 
51 - Still enrolled 
52 - No longer enrolled. Do not include in import file, will be generated.

Race/ethnicity table
1 - U.S. Nonresident
2 - Hispanic/Latino
3 - American Indian or Alaska Native
4 - Asian
5 - Black or African American
6 - Native Hawaiian or Other Pacific Islander
7 - White
8 - Two or more race
9 - Race and ethnicity unknown
10 - Total will be generated on the export file. Do not include in import file.
11 - Grand total will be generated on the export file. Do not include in import file.

Pell recipients and recipients of a Direct Subsidized Loan who did not receive a Pell Grant table (sections 2 and 3)
10. Number of students in cohort
18. Completed bachelor's degree or equivalent within 150%
29. Total completers within 150%
45. Total exclusions
